data.name: Alanah
data.gender_notes: Alanah is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'alanos' meaning 'cassia' or 'wild olive tree'. In Christian tradition, Alanah represents the light of God guiding the faithful. The name Alanah carries the meaning “Light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alanah usually hope their child will grow to embody light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine guidance and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Alanah belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alanah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name Alanah holds a deep and meaningful symbolism for those who carry it. Each time it is called or heard, it serves as a reminder of the ever-present guiding light of God, and the faith and trust that is required to navigate through life with His Divine Providence. It echoes the promise of continuing light and support, even in the darkest of days, and reinforces the belief that we are never alone.
